sentences.zh: 挑战在于，当你在报道过程中遇到如此堕落、如此令人震惊以至于必须引起重视的事情时。

sentences.en: A months-long Times investigation uncovers a digital underworld of child sexual abuse imagery that is hiding in plain sight.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》历时数月的调查揭露了一个隐藏在眼皮底下的儿童性虐待影像数字地下世界。

sentences.en: In part one, my colleagues Michael Keller and Gabriel Dance on the almost unfathomable scale of the problem.
sentences.zh: 在第一部分中，我的同事迈克尔·凯勒和加布里埃尔·丹斯将探讨这一问题几乎令人难以置信的规模。

sentences.en: And just how little is being done to stop it.
sentences.zh: 以及为阻止它所做的工作是多么的少。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, February 19th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月19日，星期三。

sentences.en: Gabriel, tell me how this investigation first got started.
sentences.zh: 加布里埃尔，告诉我这项调查最初是如何开始的。

sentences.en: So it all began with a tip.
sentences.zh: 这一切都始于一条线索。

sentences.en: Early last year, we got a tip from a guy, and this guy was looking up bullets.
sentences.zh: 去年年初，我们得到一个人的线索，这名男子当时在搜索子弹。

sentences.en: Bullets for guns.
sentences.zh: 枪支的子弹。

sentences.en: Bullets for guns.
sentences.zh: 枪支的子弹。

sentences.en: And he was actually looking for a very specific weight of bullet on Microsoft's
sentences.zh: 实际上，他当时在微软的

sentences.en: Bing search engine.
sentences.zh: 必应搜索引擎上寻找一种非常特定重量的子弹。

sentences.en: And while he was looking up these bullets, he started getting results of children being sexually abused.
sentences.zh: 当他在搜索这些子弹时，他开始看到儿童遭到性虐待的结果。

sentences.en: And the guy was horrified.
sentences.zh: 那个人吓坏了。

sentences.en: He didn't understand why he was seeing these images.
sentences.zh: 他不明白为什么自己会看到这些图像。

sentences.en: Couldn't stand to look at them.
sentences.zh: 根本不忍直视。

sentences.en: And so he reported it to Bing and heard nothing.
sentences.zh: 于是他向必应举报了此事，但没有得到任何回复。

sentences.en: And full of outrage, he writes us a letter to our tip line and described what he was looking for, described the kind of images he was getting back.
sentences.zh: 他满腔怒火，给我们爆料热线写了一封信，描述了他在寻找什么，描述了他得到的图像类型。

sentences.en: He says, New York Times, can you please look into this for me?
sentences.zh: 他说，《纽约时报》，你们能帮我查查这件事吗？

sentences.en: So I actually emailed my colleague, Michael Keller, and I asked him to look into it.
sentences.zh: 所以我给我的同事迈克尔·凯勒发了封邮件，请他调查一下。

sentences.en: So in the tip, they had listed the search terms they'd used.
sentences.zh: 所以在爆料中，他们列出了所使用的搜索词。

sentences.en: So we tried to replicate it.
sentences.zh: 于是我们试图复制它。

sentences.en: We put it into Bing.
sentences.zh: 我们把它输入到必应中。

sentences.en: And we saw a flash on the screen of images of children.
sentences.zh: 我们在屏幕上看到了儿童图像的一闪而过。

sentences.en: And so I wrote back to Gabe and said, yeah, this checks out.
sentences.zh: 所以我回信给盖布说，是的，情况属实。

sentences.en: You could type words in to Bing and get back explicit images of children.
sentences.zh: 你可以在必应中输入词语，并得到儿童的露骨图像。

sentences.en: So this is not the dark web.
sentences.zh: 所以这不是暗网。

sentences.en: This is just a regular commonplace search engine.
sentences.zh: 这只是一个普通的、常见的搜索引擎。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So a few things went through my head.
sentences.zh: 所以当时有几件事闪过我的脑海。

sentences.en: First of all is, well, we need to document this because as most of us know, things on the internet change all the time.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们需要记录下来，因为正如我们大多数人所知，互联网上的东西一直在变。

sentences.en: It's possible they came down soon after, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 它们可能不久后就被删除了，等等。

sentences.en: But we were very unsure what kind of legal liabilities we had when it came to documenting anything regarding this imagery.
sentences.zh: 但对于在记录任何有关这些图像的内容时我们会承担什么样的法律责任，我们很不确定。

sentences.en: So we emailed David McCraw, who's the head counsel at the New York Times, to ask him, you know, what can we do?
sentences.zh: 所以我们给《纽约时报》首席法律顾问大卫·麦克劳发了邮件，问他，你知道的，我们能做什么？

sentences.en: What can't we do?
sentences.zh: 我们不能做什么？

sentences.en: How do we go about investigating where this imagery is online?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何着手调查这些图像在网上的位置？

sentences.en: And doing it without somehow violating the law.
sentences.zh: 并且在这样做的同时，不会以某种方式触犯法律。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And David wrote back immediately and said, there is no journalistic privilege when investigating this.
sentences.zh: 大卫立刻回信说，在调查这件事时，没有新闻特权可言。

sentences.en: You have no protections.
sentences.zh: 你们没有任何保护。

sentences.en: And you have to report it immediately to the FBI.
sentences.zh: 你们必须立即向联邦调查局报告。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And so that's what we did.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我们所做的。

sentences.en: We submitted a report both to the FBI and also to the National
sentences.zh: 我们向联邦调查局以及国家

sentences.en: Center for Missing and Exploited Children, which is the kind of government designated clearinghouse for a lot of these reports.
sentences.zh: 失踪与被剥削儿童中心提交了一份报告，该中心是政府指定的许多此类报告的票据交换所。

sentences.en: And what did they tell you?
sentences.zh: 他们对你们说了什么？

sentences.en: They weren't able to tell us anything about the report we submitted, but it made us wonder how common is it that they get these kinds of reports?
sentences.zh: 他们无法向我们透露关于我们提交的报告的任何信息，但这让我们想知道，他们接到这类报告的频率有多高？

sentences.en: How many images are out there?
sentences.zh: 外面有多少图像？

sentences.en: How many images are flagged to them each year?
sentences.zh: 每年有多少图像被标记给他们？

sentences.en: And they were able to tell us that.
sentences.zh: 他们能够告诉我们这些。

sentences.en: And that number was frankly shocking to us.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，这个数字让我们感到震惊。

sentences.en: The handful of images that the tipster stumbled across was just a tiny portion of what the National
sentences.zh: 爆料人偶然发现的少数图像只是国家

sentences.en: Center sees every single day.
sentences.zh: 中心每天看到的冰山一角。

sentences.en: They told us that in 2018 alone, they received over 45 million images and videos.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我们，仅在2018年，他们就收到了超过4500万张图片和视频。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: 45 million images a year.
sentences.zh: 一年4500万张图片。

sentences.en: That's more than 120,000 images and videos of children being sexually abused every day.
sentences.zh: 这意味着每天有超过12万张儿童遭受性虐待的图片和视频。

sentences.en: Every single day.
sentences.zh: 每一天。

sentences.en: But to put it in perspective, 10 years ago, there were only 600,000 images and videos reported to the National Center.
sentences.zh: 但从宏观来看，10年前，向国家中心报告的图片和视频只有60万张。

sentences.en: And at that time, they were calling it an epidemic.
sentences.zh: 当时，他们称之为流行病。

sentences.en: So in just a decade, it went from 600,000 reports to 45 million.
sentences.zh: 所以在短短十年里，报告数量从60万激增到4500万。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So we were really curious.
sentences.zh: 所以我们真的很好奇。

sentences.en: How does a problem called an epidemic 10 years ago become such a massive issue now?
sentences.zh: 一个10年前被称为流行病的问题，现在怎么会变成如此巨大的危机？

sentences.en: And one of the first things we learned was that we did try and tackle it back then.
sentences.zh: 我们了解到的第一件事就是，我们当时确实尝试过解决它。

sentences.en: The national epidemic of grown men using the internet to solicit underage teens for sex.
sentences.zh: 成年男子利用互联网诱使未成年青少年进行性交易的全国性流行病。

sentences.en: As more and more parents become aware of the dangers, so have lawmakers in Washington.
sentences.zh: 随着越来越多的父母意识到这些危险，华盛顿的议员们也是如此。

sentences.en: In the mid to late 2000s, as the internet was being more widely adopted, this issue of online child sexual abuse really got on the radar of Congress.
sentences.zh: 在2000年代中后期，随着互联网得到更广泛的应用，在线儿童性虐待这一问题真正进入了国会的视野。

sentences.en: There was even a bill being introduced by Debbie
sentences.zh: 甚至还有黛比

sentences.en: Wasserman Schultz.
sentences.zh: 沃斯曼·舒尔茨提出的法案。

sentences.en: The internet has facilitated an exploding multi-billion dollar market for child pornography.
sentences.zh: 互联网催生了一个价值数十亿美元的儿童色情爆炸性市场。

sentences.en: There were multiple hearings.
sentences.zh: 举行了多次听证会。

sentences.en: I'm here today to testify about what many of my law enforcement colleagues are not free to come here and tell you.
sentences.zh: 我今天来这里作证，谈谈我的许多执法同事无法自由前来告诉你们的事情。

sentences.en: They heard from law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 他们听取了执法部门的意见。

sentences.en: We are overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 我们不堪重负。

sentences.en: We are underfunded.
sentences.zh: 我们资金不足。

sentences.en: And we are drowning in a tidal wave of tragedy.
sentences.zh: 我们在悲剧的滔天巨浪中苦苦挣扎。

sentences.en: They were overwhelmed with the number of reports that were coming in.
sentences.zh: 他们被不断涌入的报告数量压得喘不过气来。

sentences.en: Unless and until the funding is made available to aggressively investigate and prosecute possession of child pornography, federal efforts will be hopelessly diluted.
sentences.zh: 除非并直到有资金来积极调查和起诉持有儿童色情制品的行为，否则联邦的努力将被无可救药地冲淡。

sentences.en: They, in many cases, had the tools to see where offenders were, but not enough staff to actually go out and arrest the perpetrators.
sentences.zh: 在许多情况下，他们有工具看出违法者的位置，但没有足够的员工去真正出动并逮捕肇事者。

sentences.en: We don't have the resources we need to save these children.
sentences.zh: 我们没有拯救这些孩子所需的资源。

sentences.en: Hello, thank you for inviting me to speak today.
sentences.zh: 你好，谢谢你邀请我今天发言。

sentences.en: My name is Alicia Kozakevich, a
sentences.zh: 我叫艾莉西亚·科扎凯维奇，是一名

sentences.en: Pittsburgh resident.
sentences.zh: 匹兹堡居民。

sentences.en: I am 19 years old and a sophomore in college.
sentences.zh: 我今年19岁，是一名大学二年级学生。

sentences.en: There was also very chilling testimony from a victim of child sexual abuse.
sentences.zh: 还有来自一名儿童性虐待受害者的非常令人毛骨悚然的证词。

sentences.en: For the benefit of those of you who don't know, don't remember those headlines.
sentences.zh: 为了那些不认识、不记得那些头条新闻的人好。

sentences.en: I am that a black 13-year-old girl who was lured by an internet predator and enslaved by a sadistic, pedophile monster.
sentences.zh: 我就是一个被网络色狼诱骗并被虐待狂、恋童癖恶魔奴役的13岁黑人女孩。

sentences.en: In the beginning, I chatted for months with Christine, a beautiful red-haired 14-year-old girl, and we traded our school pictures.
sentences.zh: 起初，我和克里斯蒂娜聊了几个月，她是一个美丽的红发14岁女孩，我们交换了学校的照片。

sentences.en: Too bad that hers were fake.
sentences.zh: 可惜她的照片是假的。

sentences.en: Yeah, Christine was really a middle-aged pervert named John.
sentences.zh: 是的，克里斯蒂娜其实是一个名叫约翰的中年变态。

sentences.en: And he had lots of practice at his little masquerade because he had it all down.
sentences.zh: 他在自己小小的假面舞会上很有经验，因为他把一切都拿捏到位了。

sentences.en: The abbreviations, the music, the slang, the clothes.
sentences.zh: 缩写、音乐、俚语、服装。

sentences.en: He knew it all.
sentences.zh: 他什么都知道。

sentences.en: John slash Christine was to introduce me to a great friend of hers.
sentences.zh: 约翰斜杠克里斯蒂娜要将我介绍给她的一位好朋友。

sentences.en: This man was to be my abductor, my torturer.
sentences.zh: 这个男人将成为我的绑架者、我的虐待者。

sentences.en: I met him on the evening of January 1st,
sentences.zh: 我在2002年
1月1日的晚上遇到了他。

sentences.en: Imagine, suddenly you're in the car, terrified, and he's grabbing onto your hand and crushing it, and you cry out, but there's no one to hear.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，突然间你在车里，吓得要死，他抓着你的手并把它捏碎，你大声哭喊，但没有人听到。

sentences.en: In between the beatings and the raping, he will hang you by your arms while beating you, and he will share his prized pictures with his friends over the internet.
sentences.zh: 在殴打和强奸的间隙，他会把你的手臂吊起来殴打你，并且会在互联网上与他的朋友分享他珍视的照片。

sentences.en: The boogeyman is real, and he lives on the net.
sentences.zh: 恶魔是真实存在的，他就住在网络上。

sentences.en: He lived in my computer, and he lives in yours.
sentences.zh: 他曾住在我的电脑里，他也住在你的电脑里。

sentences.en: While you're sitting here, he's at home with your children.
sentences.zh: 当你坐在里时，他正和你的孩子们在家中。

sentences.en: Tax forces all over this country are poised to capture him, to put him in that prison cell with the man who hurt me.
sentences.zh: 这个国家的特遣部队随时准备抓住他，把他关进那个关押着伤害过我的男人的监狱牢房里。

sentences.en: They can do it.
sentences.zh: 他们能做到。

sentences.en: They want to do it.
sentences.zh: 他们想做到。

sentences.en: They want to do it.
sentences.zh: 他们想要做到。

sentences.en: Don't you?
sentences.zh: 你们难道不想吗？

sentences.en: Alicia's testimony really moved people.
sentences.zh: 艾莉西亚的证词深深地打动了人们。

sentences.en: People responded, and eventually, about a year later, the bill passes unanimously.
sentences.zh: 人们作出了回应，最终在大约一年后，该法案获得一致通过。

sentences.en: And what is this new law supposed to do?
sentences.zh: 这项新法律究竟打算做什么？

sentences.en: So this law, the 2008 Protect Our Children Act, is actually a pretty formidable law with some pretty ambitious goals.
sentences.zh: 所以这部法律，即2008年的《保护我们的儿童法》，其实是一部相当强大且有着相当雄心勃勃目标的法律。

sentences.en: It was supposed to, for the first time ever, secure tens of millions of dollars in annual funding for investigators working on this issue.
sentences.zh: 它本应有史以来第一次为从事这一问题研究的调查人员提供数千万美元的年度资金保障。

sentences.en: And it required the Department of Justice to really study the problem and put out reports to outline a strategy to tackle it.
sentences.zh: 它要求司法部认真研究这个问题，并发布报告以概述应对该问题的战略。

sentences.en: And what has happened since this ambitious law was put into place?
sentences.zh: 这部雄心勃勃的法律出台后，情况怎么样了？

sentences.en: In many ways, the problem has only gotten worse.
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，问题反而变得更糟了。

sentences.en: Even though the number of reports has grown into the millions, funding is still pretty much what it was 10 years ago.
sentences.zh: 尽管报告数量已经增长到数百万，但资金基本上还是10年前的水平。

sentences.en: And even though the government was supposed to do these regular reports, they've only done two in 10 years.
sentences.zh: 尽管政府本应撰写这些定期报告，但在10年里他们只写了两份。

sentences.en: And that's an issue because if you don't have anyone studying the size of the problem, you don't have anyone raising alarm bells and saying, hey, we need more resources for this.
sentences.zh: 这是一个问题，因为如果没有人研究问题的严重性，就没有人会敲响警钟并说，嘿，我们需要更多的资源来处理这件事。

sentences.en: So they didn't study it.
sentences.zh: 所以他们没有去研究。

sentences.en: And they didn't increase the funding in a way that would match the scale at which the problem is growing.
sentences.zh: 他们也没有以与问题增长规模相匹配的方式增加资金。

sentences.en: Yeah, it really looked like they had this law in 2008.
sentences.zh: 是的，看起来他们在2008年确实有了这部法律。

sentences.en: And then everyone really took their eye off the ball.
sentences.zh: 然后每个人都把视线从目标上移开了。

sentences.en: So we called Congresswoman Debbie Wasserman Schultz, who was one of the leading proponents of this bill to figure out what happened.
sentences.zh: 所以我们打电话给众议员黛比·沃斯曼·舒尔茨，她是这项法案的主要推动者之一，以弄清楚发生了什么。

sentences.en: And we are really gobsmacked to hear that she's unaware of the extent of the failings.
sentences.zh: 当听说她对这些失败的严重程度一无所知时，我们真的惊呆了。

sentences.en: She sends a letter to Attorney General William Barr, laying out a lot of our findings, requesting an accounting.
sentences.zh: 她给总检察长威廉·巴尔写了一封信，列出了我们的许多发现，并要求给个交代。

sentences.en: As far as we know, she hasn't heard anything.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，她没有收到任何回复。

sentences.en: So even the person who co-wrote the law was unaware that it was pretty much failing.
sentences.zh: 所以连该法的共同起草者都不知道它几乎彻底失败了。

sentences.en: She knew about the funding, but even she didn't know that things had gotten this bad.
sentences.zh: 她知道资金的事，但甚至连她也不知道情况已经变得如此糟糕。

sentences.en: And we wanted to figure out, now 10 years later, what kind of effect is this having to law enforcement, to the people on the ground working these cases?
sentences.zh: 我们想弄清楚，10年后的今天，这对执法部门、对在现场处理这些案件的人产生了什么样的影响？

sentences.en: And what we heard from them really shows what happens when everyone looks away.
sentences.zh: 我们从他们那里听到的话，真实展现了当所有人都选择视而不见时会发生什么。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了吗？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》App时，你的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》App，即可获得30天免费使用权。

sentences.en: Gabriel, Michael, what happens when you start reaching out to law enforcement?
sentences.zh: 加布里埃尔，迈克尔，当你们开始接触执法部门时，情况是怎样的？

sentences.en: So Mike and I probably spoke with about 20 different internet crimes against children task forces.
sentences.zh: 所以迈克和我大概和大约20个不同的打击危害儿童网络犯罪特遣队进行了交谈。

sentences.en: And these are the law enforcement agencies responsible with investigating child sexual abuse.
sentences.zh: 这些是负责调查儿童性虐待事件的执法机构。

sentences.en: To be honest, most of the time, as an investigative reporter, generally law enforcement, I mean, generally any
sentences.zh: 老实说，大多数时候，作为一名调查记者，通常执法部门，我的意思是，通常任何

sentences.en: anybody, but especially law enforcement, is not particularly interested in speaking with us.
sentences.zh: 任何人，尤其是执法部门，对和我们交谈都不是特别感兴趣。

sentences.en: Usually they don't see much to gain.
sentences.zh: 通常他们认为没什么好处可捞。

sentences.en: But surprisingly, when it came to this issue, they were not only willing to speak with us, but they were interested in speaking with us.
sentences.zh: 但令人惊讶的是，当涉及到这个问题时，他们不仅愿意和我们交谈，而且对此很感兴趣。

sentences.en: Why do you think that was?
sentences.zh: 你认为这是为什么？

sentences.en: It's partly because we were using the right terminology.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是我们使用了正确的术语。

sentences.en: And by that, I mean, we were asking them about child sexual abuse imagery, not child pornography.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们问的是儿童性虐待影像，而不是儿童色情制品。

sentences.en: And what exactly is the distinction?
sentences.zh: 那这两者到底有什么区别？

sentences.en: Well, legally, they're basically the same.
sentences.zh: 嗯，从法律上讲，它们基本上是一回事。

sentences.en: But for the people who deal with this type of crime day in, day out, who see these
sentences.zh: 但对于那些日复一日处理这种犯罪、看过这些

sentences.en: images and who speak with survivors, they know that calling it child pornography implies a bunch of things that are generally incorrect.
sentences.zh: 图像并与幸存者交谈过的人来说，他们知道称之为儿童色情制品意味着许多通常不正确的假设。

sentences.en: One is that it equates it with the adult pornography industry, which is legal and made up of consenting adults, whereas children cannot consent to the sexual behavior.
sentences.zh: 其一是，这将其等同于成人色情行业，后者是合法的，由成年人自愿参与，而儿童无法对性行为表示同意。

sentences.en: The other thing is that the crimes depicted are heinous.
sentences.zh: 另一件事是，所描绘的罪行极其恶劣。

sentences.en: And that each one of them is essentially looking at a crime scene.
sentences.zh: 而且他们每个人本质上都在看着一个犯罪现场。

sentences.en: And for that reason, they prefer to call it child sexual abuse imagery.
sentences.zh: 正因为如此，他们更倾向于称之为儿童性虐待影像。

sentences.en: But I think they also talk to us because for the law enforcement who deal with this, they very much feel that the issue is undercovered and
sentences.zh: 但我认为他们也愿意和我们交谈，因为对于处理此案的执法人员来说，他们深感这个问题受到的关注和

sentences.en: under discussed, especially considering the seriousness of the crime.
sentences.zh: 讨论还远远不够，考虑到罪行的严重性。

sentences.en: I mean, we had the kind of coordination and cooperation from these law enforcement officers that we rarely see from anybody whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们从这些执法人员那里得到的配合和协作，是我们从其他人身上几乎从未见过的。

sentences.en: They let us go out on raids with them.
sentences.zh: 他们让我们和他们一起去突击搜查。

sentences.en: They provided us with detailed reports.
sentences.zh: 他们向我们提供详细的报告。

sentences.en: They talked to us about specific cases.
sentences.zh: 他们和我们谈论具体的案件。

sentences.en: They were really, really open because they felt that as a nation, we were turning our backs on children, essentially.
sentences.zh: 他们真的非常非常坦诚，因为他们觉得作为一个国家，我们基本上是在背弃儿童。

sentences.en: And once you have that access, what do you find?
sentences.zh: 一旦你获得了这种接触权限，你发现了什么？

sentences.en: What we learned talking with all these law enforcement officers was just how this world operates.
sentences.zh: 通过与所有这些执法人员交谈，我们了解到的是这个世界是如何运作的。

sentences.en: A lot of the departments told us about the high levels of turnover they have.
sentences.zh: 许多部门告诉我们，他们的人员流动率很高。

sentences.en: We had one commander who said back when he was an investigator, he saw one image that was so shocking to him, he quit and served a tour in Iraq.
sentences.zh: 我们有一位指挥官说，当他还是个调查员时，他看到了一张让他大受震撼的图片，于是他辞职并在伊拉克服役了一轮。

sentences.en: That was his escape.
sentences.zh: 那是他的逃避方式。

sentences.en: To even see this imagery once changes your life.
sentences.zh: 哪怕只看一次这种影像都会改变你的人生。

sentences.en: And these people look at it all day long.
sentences.zh: 而这些人整天都在看着它们。

sentences.en: And then on top of that, they have to deal with the fact that, you know, their funding has not gone up whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，他们还要面对这样一个事实：你知道，他们的资金根本没有增加。

sentences.en: They're being funded at a level that means they can't do proactive investigations anymore.
sentences.zh: 他们的资金水平意味着他们再也无法进行主动调查了。

sentences.en: So they're not sitting in chat rooms trying to catch what many of them think are the worst criminals.
sentences.zh: 所以他们不会坐在聊天室里试图抓捕他们心中的那些最恶劣的罪犯。

sentences.en: They're unable to do anything really than respond to the utter flood of reports coming in from the National Center.
sentences.zh: 除了应对国家中心如潮水般涌来的大量报告，他们真的什么也做不了。

sentences.en: And because of the sheer number of reports coming in, they're forced to make some truly terrible decisions on how to prioritize who they're investigating.
sentences.zh: 由于报告数量实在太多，他们被迫在如何优先调查谁的问题上做出极其艰难的决定。

sentences.en: Like what?
sentences.zh: 比如什么？

sentences.en: The FBI told us that in addition to, of course, looking for anybody who's in immediate danger, they have to prioritize infants and toddlers.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局告诉我们，除了寻找任何处于危险之中的人之外，他们必须优先考虑婴儿和幼儿。

sentences.en: When we first got into this, we didn't even consider the idea of infants.
sentences.zh: 当我们刚开始着手时，我们甚至没有考虑过婴儿的概念。

sentences.en: And to hear that the FBI and later LAPD would say the same thing, we're prioritizing infants and toddlers and essentially not able to respond to reports of anybody older than that.
sentences.zh: 听到联邦调查局和后来的洛杉矶警察局都说同样的话——我们优先考虑婴儿和幼儿，基本上无法对任何比这更大的人的报告做出回应。

sentences.en: I mean, it really left us pretty speechless.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这确实让我们无言以对。

sentences.en: So we're learning a lot from speaking with law enforcement, but they also only have a small part of the picture.
sentences.zh: 所以我们从与执法部门的交谈中学到了很多，但他们也只掌握了全貌的一小部分。

sentences.en: We also are thinking about this tip that we got, where the tipster was able just to find these images on search engines very easily.
sentences.zh: 我们也在思考我们收到的那条线索，爆料人竟然能非常轻松地在搜索引擎上找到这些图片。

sentences.en: And so we still have this big question of how easy is it to come across this material?
sentences.zh: 所以我们仍然有一个巨大的疑问：接触到这些材料到底有多容易？

sentences.en: And how do you go about answering that question?
sentences.zh: 你又是如何着手解答这个问题的？

sentences.en: When we initially started trying to replicate the tipster search, we had to stop because we didn't want to be searching for these illegal images.
sentences.zh: 当我们最初试图复制爆料人的搜索时，我们不得不停下来，因为我们不想去搜索这些非法图片。

sentences.en: But then we discovered a technology that would allow us to keep investigating without having to look at the images.
sentences.zh: 但随后我们发现了一种技术，它能让我们继续调查，而无需观看这些图片。

sentences.en: It's called photo DNA.
sentences.zh: 它被称为PhotoDNA。

sentences.en: And it essentially creates a unique digital fingerprint for each image.
sentences.zh: 它本质上为每张图片创建一个独特的数字指纹。

sentences.en: And as the National
sentences.zh: 随着国家

sentences.en: Center is receiving these reports and identifying these illegal images of child sexual abuse, they keep track of these digital fingerprints.
sentences.zh: 中心收到这些报告并识别出这些非法的儿童性虐待图片时，他们会追踪这些数字指纹。

sentences.en: And other companies can tap into that database to see, is this image that I have, is it in that database of known images?
sentences.zh: 其他公司可以接入该数据库以查看：我手头的这张图片，是否在那个已知图片的数据库中？

sentences.en: And we stumbled upon a service from Microsoft that actually allows you to do just that.
sentences.zh: 我们无意中发现了微软的一项服务，它实际上允许你做到这一点。

sentences.en: It'll take a URL of an image and tell you if it matches an image already in that database.
sentences.zh: 它会获取图片的网址，并告诉你它是否与该数据库中已有的图片匹配。

sentences.en: So we wrote a computer program that would replicate that initial search from the tipster, record all of the URLs.
sentences.zh: 于是我们编写了一个计算机程序，来复制爆料人的最初搜索，记录下所有的网址。

sentences.en: The key part of it, though, was that it blocked all images.
sentences.zh: 不过，其中关键的一点是，它屏蔽了所有图片。

sentences.en: So suddenly you can now search for these images and find where they live on the internet without illegally looking at them.
sentences.zh: 所以你突然可以搜索这些图片，并在互联网上找到它们存放的位置，而无需非法查看它们。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So we started doing this test across a number of different search engines.
sentences.zh: 于是我们开始在多个不同的搜索引擎上进行这项测试。

sentences.en: And to sit there and watch as the program starts ticking away and see the first time it flashes that it got a match, and then to see it match again.
sentences.zh: 坐在那里看着程序开始运转，看到它第一次闪烁提示匹配成功，然后又看到它再次匹配。

sentences.en: Bing from
sentences.zh: 必应

sentences.en: Microsoft.
sentences.zh: 来自微软。

sentences.en: And match again.
sentences.zh: 再次匹配。

sentences.en: Yahoo.
sentences.zh: 雅虎。

sentences.en: And match again.
sentences.zh: 再次匹配。

sentences.en: Another one called DuckDuckGo.
sentences.zh: 另一个叫DuckDuckGo。

sentences.en: I mean, I think both our jaws dropped.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我想我们两个人的下巴都惊掉了。

sentences.en: We didn't find any on Google, but on other search engines powered by
sentences.zh: 我们在谷歌上没有找到，但在其他由

sentences.en: Microsoft data, we found a number of matches.
sentences.zh: 微软数据支持的搜索引擎上，我们找到了许多匹配项。

sentences.en: Dozens.
sentences.zh: 几十个。

sentences.en: Dozens of images.
sentences.zh: 几十张图片。

sentences.en: You're saying the company that came up with this technology to help track these images is the very
sentences.zh: 你是说，开发这项技术来帮助追踪这些图片的公司，恰恰是

sentences.en: same company whose search engine allows people to find them, view them, keep viewing them.
sentences.zh: 同一家公司，其搜索引擎允许人们找到它们、查看它们、不断地查看它们。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: As soon as we started running this computer program using Microsoft to detect illegal imagery, we were finding illegal imagery on Microsoft.
sentences.zh: 当我们开始运行这个使用微软来检测非法影像的计算机程序时，我们在微软上找到了非法的影像。

sentences.en: So it was very clear that they were not using their own services to protect users from this type of image.
sentences.zh: 所以很明显，他们没有使用自己的服务来保护用户免受此类影像的侵害。

sentences.en: And Microsoft told us that this was the result of a bug that they fixed.
sentences.zh: 微软告诉我们，这是他们已经修复的一个漏洞导致的结果。

sentences.en: But about a week later, we re-ran the test and found even more images.
sentences.zh: 但大约一周后，我们重新进行了测试，却发现了更多的图片。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So it sounds like you're finding all these images on Microsoft powered search engines.
sentences.zh: 听起来你在微软支持的搜索引擎上找到了所有这些图片。

sentences.en: So how much of this in the end is just a Microsoft problem?
sentences.zh: 那么归根结底，这在多大程度上只是一个微软的问题？

sentences.en: It's more complicated than that.
sentences.zh: 事情比这更复杂。

sentences.en: We were performing this limited search just to test search engines on images.
sentences.zh: 我们进行这种有限的搜索只是为了测试搜索引擎上的图片。

sentences.en: But we're also, at the same time, reading over 10,000 pages of court documents.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，我们也阅读了超过一万页的法庭文件。

sentences.en: These are search warrants and subpoenas from cases where people were caught trading this material.
sentences.zh: 这些是搜查令和传票，来自人们因交易这些材料而被捕的案件。

sentences.en: And what becomes clear pretty quickly is that every major tech company is implicated.
sentences.zh: 很快就很清楚的一点是，每家大型科技公司都牵涉其中。

sentences.en: In page after page after page, we see social media platforms,
sentences.zh: 在一页又一页的文件中，我们看到了社交媒体平台，

sentences.en: Facebook, Kik, Tumblr.
sentences.zh: Facebook、Kik、Tumblr。

sentences.en: We see cloud storage companies, Google Drive, Dropbox.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了云存储公司，Google Drive、Dropbox。

sentences.en: We read one case where an offender went on a Facebook group to ask for advice from other people, say, hey, how do I share this?
sentences.zh: 我们读到一个案件，其中一个犯罪分子在一个Facebook群组上向其他人寻求建议，说，嘿，我怎么分享这个？

sentences.en: How do I get access to it?
sentences.zh: 我怎么才能获取它？

sentences.en: How do I get access to children?
sentences.zh: 我怎么才能接触到儿童？

sentences.en: And they say, download Kik to talk to the kids and download Dropbox and we can share links with you.
sentences.zh: 他们说，下载Kik和孩子们聊天，下载Dropbox，我们就可以和你分享链接。

sentences.en: And from these documents, it becomes clear that the companies know.
sentences.zh: 从这些文件中，很明显这些公司是知情的。

sentences.en: I mean, there's so many cases for each company that they all know.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，每家公司都有这么多的案件，他们都是心知肚明的。

sentences.en: And so the question becomes, what are they doing about it?
sentences.zh: 所以问题就变成了，他们对此有什么行动？

sentences.en: Tomorrow on The Daily, a victim's family asks that same question.
sentences.zh: 明天在《每日新闻》节目中，一个受害者的家庭提出了同样的疑问。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: President Trump has granted clemency to a new round of high-profile individuals, including Bernie Carrick, the former New York City police commissioner who was convicted on
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统已向新一批备受瞩目的人物授予特赦，其中包括伯尼·卡里克，这位前纽约市警察局长曾被裁定犯有

sentences.en: eight felony charges, including tax fraud.
sentences.zh: 八项重罪，包括税务欺诈。

sentences.en: Michael Milken, the financier convicted of insider trading.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·米尔肯，因内幕交易而被定罪的金融家。

sentences.en: And Rod Blagojevich, the former governor of Illinois, who was convicted of trying to sell
sentences.zh: 以及罗德·布拉戈耶维奇，这位前伊利诺伊州长曾被判试图出售

sentences.en: Barack Obama's Senate seat after he became president.
sentences.zh: 巴拉克·奥巴马在他当选总统后空出的参议院席位。

sentences.en: Yes, we have commuted the sentence of Rod Blagojevich.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们已经减免了罗德·布拉戈耶维奇的刑期。

sentences.en: He served eight years in jail.
sentences.zh: 他在监狱里服刑了八年。

sentences.en: It's a long time.
sentences.zh: 这是一段很长的时间。

sentences.en: Asked about Blagojevich, who Trump ordered released from prison four years early,
sentences.zh: 当被问及特朗普下令提前四年释放出狱的布拉戈耶维奇时，

sentences.en: the president mentioned his wife's public pleas on Fox News and Blagojevich's appearance on Trump's
sentences.zh: 总统提到了他妻子在福克斯新闻上的公开求情，以及布拉戈耶维奇在特朗普的

sentences.en: NBC TV show, Celebrity Apprentice.
sentences.zh: 全国广播公司电视节目《学徒》中的出场。

sentences.en: I watched his wife on television.
sentences.zh: 我在电视上看到了他的妻子。

sentences.en: I don't know him very well.
sentences.zh: 我跟他不是很熟。

sentences.en: I've met him a couple of times.
sentences.zh: 我见过他几次。

sentences.en: He was on for a short while of The Apprentice years ago.
sentences.zh: 他多年前在《学徒》里待过一小会儿。

sentences.en: Seemed like a very nice person.
sentences.zh: 看起来是个非常好的人。

sentences.en: And on Tuesday, after a new poll showed him surging in the Democratic primary race,
sentences.zh: 周二，在最新民调显示他在民主党初选中支持率飙升后，

sentences.en: Michael Bloomberg qualified for the next presidential debate, scheduled for tonight in Las Vegas.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·布隆伯格获得了参加下一场总统辩论的资格，辩论定于今晚在拉斯维加斯举行。

sentences.en: The poll, conducted by NPR, PBS, and Marist College, showed Bloomberg with 19 percent support, putting him in second place behind Bernie Sanders.
sentences.zh: 由NPR、PBS和马里斯特学院进行的民调显示，布隆伯格获得19%的支持率，位居伯尼·桑德斯之后排在第二位。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正在为假期的亲友接待做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人们宾至如归的妙招。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是深度睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会晕厥过去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症、食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》App或你喜欢的任何播客平台搜索《Wirecutter秀》。

sentences.en: What time do they make?
sentences.zh: 他们几点做饭？
